title: refactor(types)!: delete SubqueryNode and the filter builder configuration pair nothing reads

_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoGkWmgZR7t1GLVZ3tjBQgX3)_

Part of #25921 (batch 12, claim 6703671714 with amendment 6703700084 naming the batch and its three rulings; the card's other open items stay on it)

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：从 `@object-ui/types` 的 `data-protocol.ts` 删除 3 个没人读的类型：查询 AST 的 `SubqueryNode`，以及过滤器构建器配置一组的 `FilterBuilderConfig`、`FilterFieldConfig`。
- 为什么改：#25921 清理零消费者公开面；这 3 个名字在仓内与 hotcrm 都没有任何引用，没有任何查询构建器或过滤器 UI 构造或读取它们，留着会被当成 UI 协议包的公开承诺。
- 风险与回滚：纯类型删除，构建出的 JavaScript 不变；同模块的其它查询节点类型与 `DateRangeFilter` 原样保留。对外部 npm 使用者是破坏性变更，带一个 `!` patch changeset（BREAKING、FROM/TO、ADR-0087 `runtime-export-retired` 3 个）。另外按席位裁决修正了第 8 批待发 changeset 里一句「`FilterBuilderConfig` 保持导出」的话（DELIBERATE CORRECTION，见下）。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/types/src/data-protocol.ts`（删掉的声明与退役注释）、`.changeset/25921-types-subquery-filter-builder.md`（迁移说明）、`.changeset/25921-types-driver-datasource-block.md`（被修正的一句）。
- 两分钟验证：`git grep -lw -e SubqueryNode -e FilterBuilderConfig -e FilterFieldConfig -- ui packages` 预期只命中 `ui/packages/types` 里的退役注释与本 changeset；`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/types/` 预期全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

`@object-ui/types` (its `.` entry) loses 3 types of `src/data-protocol.ts`. They are deleted from the module, not only from the entry:

`SubqueryNode`, `FilterBuilderConfig`, `FilterFieldConfig`.

- `src/data-protocol.ts`: the "Subquery node (Phase 3.3.3)" interface and the "Filter builder configuration (Phase 3.4.5)" pair go, each replaced by a two-line retirement comment. `FilterBuilderDateRangePreset`'s JSDoc said its eight future windows serve "the `FilterBuilderConfig` surface below"; it now names `DateRangeFilter`'s `preset`, the one remaining reader (ruling 3).
- `src/index.ts`: the three names leave the `./data-protocol.js` type list; a comment at each spot names them.
- `src/__tests__/phase35-validation-types-retired-10719.test.ts`: its second firing control used `FilterFieldConfig` as "the neighbouring filter type"; it now uses `DateRangeFilter`, same matcher, same module, kept (ruling 1, option A). The absence assertion and the `ObjectValidationRule` control are unchanged.
- `.changeset/25921-types-subquery-filter-builder.md`: one `!` patch changeset, BREAKING, FROM/TO per name (no replacement in this package), and the ADR-0087 `runtime-export-retired` marker naming all 3.
- `.changeset/25921-types-driver-datasource-block.md`: one sentence corrected, see below.

`data-protocol.ts` is reached only through the `.` entry; no subpath entry of the package exports it.

### DELIBERATE CORRECTION of a pending release note

`.changeset/25921-types-driver-datasource-block.md` (batch 8, still pending) listed `FilterBuilderConfig` among the `data-protocol.ts` names that stay exported. Both changesets compile into the same release, so that sentence would publish as false next to this batch's BREAKING note. Seat ruling 2 (amendment 6703700084, option A): delete only that name from that sentence and touch nothing else in the file. The corrected sentence now reads:

> Every other name of `data-protocol.ts` stays exported unchanged, among them `DriverQueryConfig`, `SqlQueryAST`, the query-AST node types, `AdvancedFilterSchema` and `ObjectValidationRule` with its variants.

`check-empty-changeset` stays red on this file by design (the DELIBERATE CORRECTION class); the dispatching seat's record confirms it.

## Tests

- One in-package test changes: the firing control above. No other test reads the 3 names.
- No ablation: a deletion of types with no tested behaviour behind it. The reverse probe below is the proof that the built `.d.ts` is the one read.

## Acceptance notes

- Still open on #25921 after this batch, in `@object-ui/types`: `field-types.ts`'s `VisibilityCondition` (an objectui#12242 orphan; its neighbour `FieldValidationFunction` stays because the one-authority gate's remedy text under `ui/scripts` teaches it, and `FieldConstraints` is module-local, not on the entry), `AuditFieldName`, `ContainerSchemaWithChildren`, and the two `designer.ts` blocks (Unified View with the objectui#12063 tombstone pin, Dashboard with a zod twin). `DataContext`, `EventHandlers` and `StyleProps` have no readers but sit on the `./data` and `./base` subpath entries, which the claim fences. The seven `Spec*` spec/ui aliases still wait on a predicate-2 ruling. `types/src/ai.ts` keeps its tombstones until the sunset rule of #25912; not touched here.
